papers.title: Lease
papers.original: Kleinreparaturen bis 120 Euro je Reparatur, hoechstens 300 Euro im Jahr, traegt der Mieter. Schoenheitsreparaturen und Duebelloecher sind bei Rueckgabe vom Mieter zu beseitigen. Der Vermieter traegt Instandsetzung an Gebäude, Leitungen und Heizung.
papers.summary: You cover small repairs up to 120 euros each, and 300 euros in a year. Holes are yours to fill when you leave. Frau Adler covers the building, the pipes, and the heating.
papers.translation: Small repairs up to 120 euros each, and at most 300 euros a year, are the tenant's. Cosmetic repairs and drilled holes are made good by the tenant when the apartment is returned. The landlord carries repairs to the building, the pipes, and the heating.

papers.title: Electricity, October
papers.original: Abschlag November 96 Euro. Jahresverbrauch geschaetzt 2800 kWh. Zaehlerstand wurde nicht abgelesen.
papers.summary: This bill is still an estimate. No one read the meter. The supplier assumes 2800 kWh for the year, and the November advance is 96 euros.
papers.translation: November advance payment 96 euros. Yearly use estimated at 2800 kWh. The meter was not read.

papers.title: House rules
papers.original: Ruhe von 22 bis 6 Uhr. Muelltonnen am Vorabend der Abholung rausstellen.
papers.summary: Quiet from 10 at night until 6 in the morning. Bins go out the evening before collection.
papers.translation: Quiet hours from 10 p.m. to 6 a.m. Put the bins out the evening before collection.

issues.title: Damp in the corner
issues.reason: If the wall is cold and the room was kept shut, the airing is yours. If the plaster is wet from outside, it is Frau Adler's.
diy: Wipe the spot and keep a note of the date
Air the room for ten minutes, heating on low
Leave a gap behind furniture on that wall
issues.askLandlordWhen: The spot grows, or the plaster is soft

issues.title: Holes from a shelf
issues.reason: The lease says drilled holes are filled before the keys go back. This sits inside the repair cap only if a tradesperson does a small fix. Filling them yourself costs filler, not the cap.
diy: Fill, let it dry, fill again if it sinks
Touch the paint only on the patch
issues.askLandlordWhen: The hole is in tile or in a pipe chase

issues.title: The kitchen tap drips
issues.reason: A drip from a worn washer is a small repair. You pay up to 120 euros for this one. The year still has 260 euros of the cap left.
diy: Put a bowl under it tonight
Turn the shutoff under the sink if it worsens
issues.askLandlordWhen: Water comes from the wall, not the spout

issues.title: Smoke alarm chirps
issues.reason: You keep the alarm able to sound. A yearly check is yours. A dead unit that was never installed is Frau Adler's.
diy: Replace the battery if it still chirps
Photograph the unit after the test
issues.askLandlordWhen: There is no alarm in a room that should have one
